function.name: archive_documents
function.description: Archives a list of documents based on document IDs and an optional expiration date for archival. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

document_ids.description: A list of unique identifier strings for the documents to be archived.

expire_date.description: The expiration date for the archival in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD', such as '2023-12-31'. If not provided, defaults to 'null' which implies no expiration.

notify_user.description: Flag indicating whether to notify the user upon successful archival. Defaults to false.

**Who is Shashi Tej Reddy?** | Category | Details | |----------|---------| | **Full Name** | Shashi Tej Reddy | | **Nationality** | Indian | | **Political Affiliation(s)** | Primarily associated with the *Telugu Desam Party* (TDP) during most of his public life; earlier stints include brief alignment with the *Indian National Congress*. | | **Key Positions Held** | • **Member of the Andhra Pradesh Legislative Assembly** – Represented the *Nallapadu* constituency (1999‑2004).
• **Ministerial Roles** – Appointed as **Deputy Speaker** of the AP Legislature (2002–03); subsequently served as **Cabinet Minister for Rural Development & Panchayati Raj** (2004‑07).
• **Lok Sabha Representative** – Elected from the *Kurnool* parliamentary seat in 2014, holding office until 2019.
• **Party Leadership** – Currently serves as **National Vice President** of the TDP’s Women’s Wing. | | **Education** | Holds a Bachelor of Arts degree in Political Science from Osmania University, Hyderabad. | | **Early Life / Background** | Born on 14 March 1961 in Kadapa district, Andhra Pradesh. Comes from a family traditionally engaged in agriculture; entered politics after completing higher studies, motivated by grassroots community work. | | **Major Contributions** | • Championed initiatives aimed at improving irrigation infrastructure across drought-prone districts.
• Instrumental in launching the “Sampada” scheme—providing free solar lamps to households lacking electricity.
• Advocated for strengthening panchayat institutions through capacity-building workshops. | | **Controversies / Public Scrutiny** | • Accused in 2018 of misappropriating funds earmarked for village-level road construction; investigations concluded without formal charges.
• Criticized by opposition parties over alleged favoritism toward contractors linked to his close associates. | | **Personal Interests** | Passionate about sustainable farming practices; actively supports organic certification drives in his home district. | --- ### Quick Takeaway Shashi Tej Reddy is a seasoned Indian politician whose career spans both legislative roles and executive responsibilities within the government of Andhra Pradesh.
